name: omnilab/ned
description: Omnilab NED: an object of the NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database - a galaxy, a quasar, a cluster, a radio source - by any of its names: its preferred name, type, J2000 position with its uncertainty, redshift with its uncertainty and quality, galactic coordinates, and how many references, photometric points, redshift-independent distances, images and spectra NED holds for it; the objects of a cone on the sky - through NED's ObjectLookup and TAP services, no key needed.
